title: What Actually Matters More Than Chasing The Best Models
description:
Daniel Jones makes it clear: it's pointless to argue whether GPT is better than Claude.

What actually matters is something most developers aren't even thinking about, and he gives developers 3 tips they need to follow to improve their agent outputs.

In this episode of AI Native Dev, Simon Maple sits down with Daniel Jones, Partner at re:cinq, to get into what actually determines whether agentic coding works.

You'll hear them talk about:
• why agent ergonomics matter more than raw model intelligence
• why non-determinism breeds superstition
• why context management beats prompt engineering every time
• the 3 rules to follow every time you talk to your agent

By the end of this one, you'll rethink everything you thought you knew about working with LLMs.
